description: What you did and what you saw. A value on base makes a baseline. Checkmate compares it on each later build.

value.description: The exact value to compare on a later build, for example 45.00 or HTTP 409.

repeats.description: The ID of an earlier observation that you did again. Without it, Checkmate links a value to the one earlier value with the same about and steps, or the same ID without the build name (total-b1, total-base). none: no link.

verdict.description: ok when the result is correct. wrong when it is not.

via.description: The entry point that you used.
